newsitem.title: POLAND: PPABank rights second leg oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: PPABank rights second leg oversubscribed.

text.p: Shareholders of Poland's Pierwszy Polsko-Amerykanski Bank SA subscribed for 1,332,987 shares in the second subscription period for 179,271 shares in the firm's rights issue, PPABank said in a statement.
The bank said on Wednesday that it would reduce the orders in the issue's second phase, which took place in February and March, but gave no details.
During the first subscription period in January and February investors subscribed for 1,070,729 shares with 1.25 million shares on offer.
